notes.subject: נמשל/נדמו
notes.rationale: root-play between משל (to be likened) and דמה (to perish/be silenced): 'he is likened... they are destroyed' — the sound echo is lost in Bamanankan

notes.subject: ביקר
notes.rationale: 'yɛrɛyɛrɛ' renders 'preciousness/honour'; concrete sense 'wealth' (as in verse 7) also possible

notes.subject: נדמו
notes.rationale: root דמה means 'be dumb/silent' — 'they are silenced' as well as 'they perish'

translation: Hadamaden min bɛ yɛrɛyɛrɛ la n'a m'a dɔn, a bɛ taama i n'a fɔ baganw minnu banna.

tokens.gloss: a bɛ taama i n'a fɔ
